title: Power Setpoint Tracking for Large-Scale EV Charging: Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning with Self-Tuning Constraint Prices
abstract: arXiv:2611.25965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In power setpoint tracking (PST), an operator follows a purchased charging profile without overloading shared transformers or undercharging vehicles. PST is cast as a constrained Markov decision process that minimizes tracking error subject to overload and mean user-satisfaction constraints. Transformer-Constrained Charging Policy Learning (TC-CPL) extends soft actor-critic with proportional-integral Lagrange-multiplier updates from measured violations, a residual on the incumbent dispatcher that is warm-started from its demonstrations, and a transformer-aware encoder shared by all ports. It observes no departure times or states of charge. Simulations (five seeds, 100 paired days) compare it with the incumbent, Round-Robin. On a 600-port, 122-substation district, raw overload falls from 3.59 to 0.0017 kWh/day (overloaded seed-days from 77% to 0.4%), and absolute tracking error falls by 27%. Delivered energy rises by 16%, and satisfaction

translated_title: 大规模电动汽车充电的功率设定点跟踪：基于自整定约束价格的变压器约束充电策略学习
translated_abstract: 在功率设定点跟踪（PST）中，运营方需要按照已购买的充电功率曲线运行，同时避免共享变压器过载或对车辆充电不足。PST被建模为一个受约束的马尔可夫决策过程，在变压器过载约束和平均用户满意度约束下最小化跟踪误差。变压器约束充电策略学习（TC-CPL）在软演员-评论家（soft actor-critic）算法基础上进行了扩展：基于实测违规量的比例-积分拉格朗日乘子自整定更新、以现有调度器的演示数据热启动的残差修正项，以及由所有充电端口共享的变压器感知编码器。该方法无需观测车辆的离开时间或荷电状态。仿真实验（五个随机种子、100个配对日）将其与现有方法轮询调度（Round-Robin）进行对比。在一个拥有600个充电端口、122个变电站的区域内，原始过载从每天3.59 kWh降至0.0017 kWh（过载种子日比例从77%降至0.4%），绝对跟踪误差降低27%，输送能量增加16%，用户满意度（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出TC-CPL方法，通过比例-积分自整定约束价格、热启动残差策略和变压器感知编码器，在大规模EV充电功率设定点跟踪中实现近乎零变压器过载并显著降低跟踪误差，且无需观测车辆离开时间或荷电状态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TC-CPL, a transformer-constrained charging policy learning method with self-tuning constraint prices via proportional-integral Lagrange multipliers, warm-started residual policies, and a transformer-aware encoder, achieving near-zero transformer overload and reduced tracking error in large-scale EV charging without observing departure times or states of charge.
